_about: Slice of life and cozy: a community, the season, small troubles, nobody dies. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

need: the bakery needs a new oven
the bridge needs mending before the fair
the library is closing unless someone helps
a lost pet must be found
the festival needs a new song
trouble: a recipe that will not come right
a visitor who does not fit in
a letter with bad news from far away
newcomer: a former rival moving in next door
tradition: planting a tree for each newborn

cliches: the big city developer wants to buy the town
the grumpy old man has a heart of gold
everything is solved by a bake sale
